Durable Power of Attorney Summary
ClearLegacy fictional demonstration household
FICTIONAL DEMO RECORD - NOT REAL CLIENT DATA
Document ID: JOHNSON-POA-2014

Principal: Robert James Johnson, of San Diego County, California.

Agent: "I hereby appoint my brother, Thomas Johnson, as my attorney-in-fact to act for me with respect to banking and brokerage transactions, retirement plans, real property, and tax matters."

Successor agent: No successor agent is named.

Durability: "This power of attorney shall not be affected by my subsequent incapacity."

Governing law: California. Signed on September 9, 2014.

This is a fictional summary for demonstration. It is not a legal document and has not been reviewed by an attorney.
